events.verdict: Prior to the inbound pass, Ferguson (OKC) and Redick (PHI) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Adams (OKC) is drawn in the air and deflects the basketball, and the inadvertent contact to Redick's (PHI) head is deemed marginal.
The Thunder are issued a Delay of Game violation.
Embiid (PHI) makes body to body contact with Westbrook (OKC) that affects his SQBR.
Simmons (PHI) is firming up and delivers slight contact to Grant (OKC) while setting the pick.
Butler (PHI) briefly places a hand on Adams' (OKC) hip without affecting his FOM.
Grant (OKC) makes marginal contact with Butler (PHI) that does not affect his drive to the basket.
[Observable in enhanced video] Butler (PHI) takes a third step after his gather on the spin move.
Grant (OKC) fails to maintains his verticality and makes contact to Butler's (PHI) body that affect his driving shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] George (OKC) splits his feet on the perimeter.
George (OKC) does not take more than two steps after his gather.
Butler (PHI) makes contact with George's (OKC) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Embiid (PHI) slightly extends his arm into Ferguson's (OKC) path while setting the screen.
Westbrook (OKC) makes contact with Embiid's (PHI) arm that affects his jump shot attempt.
Simmons (PHI) maintains legal guarding position while defending Schroder's (OKC) dribble.
Adams (OKC) sets the screen on Butler (PHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Butler (PHI) makes contact with George's (OKC) body on the follow through that affects his ability to land safely following the jump shot attempt.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a three-point field goal attempt by George (OKC) is confirmed.
Ferguson (OKC) legally contests Butler's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
